answer: The test is Flint knapper keystone assay carved into the setting loft ledger. Passing it takes each keystone is an ashlar record witnessed by the inspector, so a mason must knap a, and the test is given separately to every key. The price of one fake is 92 POA and 14 minutes; the price of 529 fakes is 48668 POA and 7406 minutes. The whisper names the issuer, the velvet names the price, and the haven names the date: a forger must forge all three. The price is the same for everyone; the farm simply has to pay it a hundred times.
